title: Leo Moon:
all about you.
summary: What Vedic astrology reads in a Leo Moon: the Sun, fire, the gift and the catch, love, work, and the three birth stars inside the sign.
imageAlt: Maya holding a Leo flag, with a lion beside her
inside: The Sun, fire and the fixed quality, and what each is read to give you
The gift and the catch, then love, work, money and energy
The three birth stars inside Leo, in a table you can look yourself up in
Five things to do with a Leo Moon
intro: If the Moon was in Leo when you were born, Vedic astrology reads you as the one who lights up the room. Warm, loyal, generous, and happiest when the people you love are close and doing well. The film says that in sixty seconds. This guide takes the long way round: where that nature is said to come from, what it is good for, where it trips you up, and how the tradition tells one Leo Moon from another.

A note before you start. Everything here is what the tradition reads from the sign, said as a tendency and never as a rule. Your Moon sign is one part of a chart, and the rest of your chart, your upbringing and your own choices all shape how much of this you recognise.

sections.label: What you are made of
title: The Sun, fire,
and a sign that holds.
paragraphs: Every sign has a ruler, an element and a quality. For Leo those are the Sun, fire and fixed. Together they explain almost everything said about the sign.

Leo is the fifth of the twelve signs, and its symbol is the lion. The tradition reads the lion plainly: a creature that does not need to prove its strength, that rests in the sun, and that guards its own.

items.name: The ruler: the Sun
items.text: The Sun is the king among the planets: the centre, the light, the sense of self. Leo is the only sign the Sun rules, so a Moon in Leo is read as a heart that wants to shine and to be seen shining. You tend to feel most like yourself when you are giving something warm to the people around you, and least like yourself when you are ignored.

items.name: The element: fire
items.text: Aries, Leo and Sagittarius are the three fire signs. Fire is read as warmth, enthusiasm and courage. In Leo it is the fire people gather round: steady, bright and good company on a cold night.

items.name: The quality: fixed
items.text: Signs are movable, fixed or dual. Leo is fixed, along with Taurus, Scorpio and Aquarius. Fixed signs are read as keepers: they hold on to people, promises and opinions. Fixed fire is the hearth, where movable fire is the spark. It burns for a long time, and it does not like being moved.

sections.label: The gift and the catch
title: Generosity first,
pride second.
paragraphs: The gift is generosity. Not only with money or presents, but with time, praise and attention. A Leo Moon is read as the friend who remembers the birthday, cheers loudest at the show, and gives away the last slice of cake without thinking twice. People tend to feel bigger around you, because you make them feel seen.

The catch is pride. The same strong sense of self that makes you warm can make it hard to admit you need help, and harder still to say sorry first. The tradition reads this kindly: it is less arrogance than a fear of looking small. The lion would rather carry the heavy box alone than let anyone see it struggle. The people who love you usually want to help, and letting them is a gift to them too.

sections.label: Love
title: All in,
and loyal.
paragraphs: In love a Leo Moon is said to be all in. When you choose someone, you choose them out loud, and you tend to stay. The tradition reads this Moon as loyal, warm and protective, with one honest need: to feel appreciated.

items.name: What you bring
items.text: Warmth, loyalty and big gestures. You tend to plan the special evening, defend your partner in public, and make them feel like the most important person in the room.

items.name: What you need
items.text: Praise, said plainly and often, and a partner who is proud to be with you. This Moon is said to wilt when it feels taken for granted, and to bloom when someone simply notices what it does.

items.name: What tends to go wrong
items.text: Hurt pride. A small slight can feel like a large one, and the lion tends to go quiet rather than say what hurt. The fix the tradition suggests is small: name the hurt early, and ask for the praise you need instead of waiting to be guessed.

items.name: Work
items.text: At work a Leo Moon is read as someone who takes the stage. You tend to do well where you can lead, present, create or be responsible for something people can see. Put you in charge and the team is said to stand a little taller, because you believe in them out loud. Work that is invisible, with no thanks and no result to point to, tends to drain this Moon.

items.name: With a boss or a team
items.text: You are said to give your best to people who respect you, and to dig in when you feel talked down to. It helps to ask for recognition directly and to say what you want to be known for. When you lead, share the credit generously: it costs a Leo nothing and wins a lot.

items.name: Money
items.text: In plain terms the tradition reads this Moon as generous with money, sometimes more than is wise: treating friends, buying the better thing, paying for the table. It says nothing certain about how much money comes your way. The habit that is said to help most is deciding in advance how much to give, so generosity stays a joy and not a worry.

items.name: Energy
items.text: Your energy is read as steady and strong when you feel valued, and low when you feel overlooked. Sunlight, play and time doing something creative tend to refill you. Rest is not laziness for a lion; it is how the fire keeps burning.

sections.label: Look yourself up
title: The three birth stars
inside Leo.
paragraphs: The sky is also divided into twenty-seven birth stars, called nakshatras, each 13°20′ wide. Three of them fall inside the thirty degrees of Leo. Which one your Moon was in is your birth star, and the tradition uses it to tell one Leo Moon from another. Each star has a ruling planet of its own, which colours the Sun and fire underneath. Your chart shows the degree of your Moon; find it in the left column.

rows.note: The throne, the star of the ancestors. Read as the most regal Leo Moon: proud of where it comes from, loyal to family and tradition, comfortable with authority. The catch is wanting respect before it has been given.

The front legs of the bed, the star of rest and pleasure. Read as the most playful and romantic Leo Moon: charming, creative, generous with affection and fond of comfort. The catch is putting off the hard part for the fun part.

rows.v: Uttara Phalguni (first quarter), ruled by the Sun
rows.note: The back legs of the bed, the star of friendship and promises. Only the first quarter of this star is in Leo; the rest is in Virgo. Read as the most dependable Leo Moon: a steady friend, a fair leader, someone who keeps their word. The catch is taking on everyone's load.

after: If your Moon sits within a degree of one of these borders, the exact time of birth decides which side it falls on. All three are still Leo, with the Sun as the sign ruler. The birth star adds a second voice, it does not replace the first.

sections.label: What to do
title: Five habits
for a Leo Moon.
paragraphs: None of this is about shining less. It is about giving a warm, proud nature what it needs to stay warm, and to let other people in.

steps.name: Let someone else shine sometimes
steps.text: Hand over the stage now and then: let a friend tell the story, let a colleague present the win. It will not dim you. A lion is said to look strongest when it is relaxed.

steps.name: Ask for help before you need it
steps.text: Pick one small thing this week and ask someone to help with it. Practising on small things makes the big asks much easier when they come.

steps.name: Say sorry first
steps.text: When something goes wrong between you and someone you love, try being the first to say it. It is the bravest thing a proud heart can do, and it usually ends the standoff in a minute.

steps.name: Ask for the praise you need
steps.text: Instead of waiting to be noticed, tell the people close to you what kind of appreciation lands for you. Most of them will be glad to know.

steps.name: Make something
steps.text: Fire under the Sun wants to create. Cook, draw, perform, build: anything that ends with something you made. It tends to steady the mood better than any compliment.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads your nature and your timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I’m a Leo Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Leo. Many people with a Leo Sun have their Moon somewhere else, and Vedic signs are counted from the stars, so even your Sun sign may differ. Your birth chart shows your Moon sign in a few seconds.

faq.q: How do I find my birth star?
faq.a: From the degree of your Moon, which your birth chart shows. The Moon moves about thirteen degrees a day, so you need your date, place and time of birth. Draw your chart on the home page and look for the Moon’s sign and degree.

note: Sign rulers, elements, qualities and birth stars are those of the classical tradition. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, Lahiri ayanamsa, read by Moon sign.
